0022600119.text: The Wizards (1-1, 2nd in the Southeast and 5th in the East) are on a one-game losing streak, and the Hornets (1-1, 3rd in the Southeast and 8th in the East) are also coming off a loss. Washington is missing AJ Dybantsa (ankle sprain), Jamir Watkins (knee surgery) and Tristan Vukcevic (hip pinched nerve), while Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring) and Kylan Boswell (knee surgery). The Wizards lost 0-4 to the Hornets in the 2025-26 season series, most recently 129-112 in Washington on February 22, 2026, and the 2026-27 season series has no games yet.
